additional_info.subject: ID0387292-DC/Si-D/FI[qHGJgs] - Numerous 0 sessions. CRM:00315001980
additional_info.body:
Hello Markus,
As we checked today, there seems to be a problem with the OCPP backend regarding the ConnectorIDs
22318 is connector ID 1 in config but is asked for ID 3
22319 is connector ID 2 in config but is asked for ID 4
22311 is connector ID 3 in config but is asked for ID 1
22312 is connector ID 4 in config but is asked for ID 2
Please check with the backend and let me know what you find.
Best regards,
Francisco
